title.en: The One With the Tour Guide

description.es: Marta y Cloe terminan su recorrido por Toledo. Cloe flirtea con el guía turístico, le pide su número y le toma la mano mientras lo apunta. Marta se queda sorprendida.
description.en: Marta and Cloe finish their Toledo tour. Cloe flirts with the tour guide, asks for his number, and holds his hand while taking it. Marta is surprised.
